headline: Ramayana is expected to reach 1.41M tickets today (1.17M–1.65M), while Jailer 2 and Aadarsha Kutumbam are forecast at 25.8K and 28.6K.
bullets: Namit Malhotra's Ramayana has 117K so far and is forecast at 1.41M today (1.17M–1.65M), with its busiest hour ahead at 8–9 PM, around 95.4K (53.1K–138K).
Jailer 2 is expected to peak at 11 AM–12 PM at about 1.8K (1.6K–2K), and Aadarsha Kutumbam at 6–7 PM at about 2K (1.2K–2.7K), with today's totals at 25.8K and 28.6K.
Tomorrow is a weekday, so all three are expected lower: Ramayana 804K (512K–1.21M), Jailer 2 13.4K (8.6K–20.3K), Aadarsha Kutumbam 14.9K (9.5K–22.5K).

Ramayana is an opening-weekend film, so its range is wide; its BookMyShow rating (9.3/10) and critics (7.8/10) nudge the forecast up about 10%, while word of mouth is mixed. Jailer 2 and Aadarsha Kutumbam have no review or rating signals, as those are only collected for films switched on.
watch: Ramayana's 8–9 PM peak has a very wide range (53.1K–138K), so evening sales will decide how close today lands to the forecast.
Jailer 2 and Aadarsha Kutumbam rest on the usual pattern alone, so any shift in their pace since 11 AM would move these numbers.
